INSERT INTO GOLF_RENTAL_FAIL_LOG ( RCP_INF_SEQ, RCP_SEQ, ORDER_NO, TYPE, ORDER_STAT_CD, MESSAGE, REG_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{rcpInfSeq}, #{rcpSeq}, #{orderNo}, #{type}, #{orderStatCd}, #{message}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}, TYPE = #{type}, ORDER_STAT_CD = #{orderStatCd}, MESSAGE = #{message}, REG_DTTM = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE GOLF_RENTAL_FAIL_LOG SET MESSAGE = 'SUCCESS', REG_DTTM = NOW() WHERE RCP_INF_SEQ = #{rcpInfSeq} AND RCP_SEQ = #{rcpSeq}
mapper.select: WITH FAIL_LOGS AS ( SELECT A.*, B.TYPE, B.ORDER_NO, B.MESSAGE, B.ORDER_STAT_CD, B.REG_DTTM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.RCP_INF_SEQ, A.RCP_SEQ ORDER BY B.REG_DTTM DESC) AS RN FROM GOLF_RECEIPT_INF A INNER JOIN GOLF_RENTAL_FAIL_LOG B ON A.RCP_INF_SEQ = B.RCP_INF_SEQ AND A.RCP_SEQ = B.RCP_SEQ WHERE B.MESSAGE != 'SUCCESS' ) SELECT * FROM FAIL_LOGS WHERE RN = 1;
